patient_actor_hidden.History: The patient complains of persistent fatigue and reports poor sleep quality. He mentions adopting a vegetarian diet in recent months to improve his energy levels but hasn't noticed significant benefits. The patient reports losing weight without trying over the last month.
patient_actor_hidden.Social_History: Smokes 1 pack of cigarettes per day and consumes 5 alcoholic beverages per day.
patient_actor_hidden.Review_of_Systems: The patient does not report any fever, abdominal pain, or changes in bowel habits.

objective_for_doctor: Assess and diagnose the patient presenting with fatigue, weight loss, and jaundice.

turns.doctor_opening: Hello, what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what's been going on?
turns.patient_opening: “I’ve been dealing with persistent fatigue and my sleep quality has been poor. Over the last month I’ve unintentionally lost weight, and I’ve also noticed some yellowing.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any swelling in your joints?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any swelling in my joints. I’ve mostly just had the fatigue, poor sleep, unintentional weight loss, and the yellowing that started around the same time.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any bumps, sores, or unusual spots on your scalp?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any bumps, sores, or unusual spots on my scalp. I’ve mainly had the fatigue, poor sleep, unintentional weight loss, and the yellowing.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been experiencing any itching or a feeling of itchiness anywhere on your body?
turns.patient_answer: “I’ve noticed some mild itching over the past few weeks, and it seems to get worse at night. I don’t have any rash or sores—just an itch.”

turns.doctor_question: Do you have any trouble lifting your arms above your head?
turns.patient_answer: “Not really—I can lift my arms above my head without any trouble.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any loss of vision that isn’t accompanied by pain?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any loss of vision or any changes in my eyesight. I mostly just feel tired, my sleep has been poor, I’ve lost weight unintentionally, I’ve noticed yellowing, and the itching has been getting worse at night.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you had a fever that’s felt extremely hot—like a temperature above 104 °F (40 °C) that’s made you feel dizzy or very uncomfortable?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t had a fever like that, and I haven’t felt dizzy or extremely unwell from a high temperature. It’s mostly been the ongoing fatigue, poor sleep, unintentional weight loss, yellowing, and the itching that worsens at night.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been feeling unusually stressed or overwhelmed lately?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I wouldn’t say I’ve been unusually stressed or overwhelmed. It feels more like the symptoms just keep persisting—fatigue, poor sleep, the weight loss, the yellowing, and the itching that’s worse at night.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you experienced any burning or discomfort when you urinate?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any burning or discomfort when I urinate.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been feeling chills lately?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t had chills. It’s mainly the persistent fatigue, poor sleep, unintentional weight loss, the yellowing, and the itching that seems worse at night.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any lumps or masses in your breasts that feel fixed or don’t move?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any lumps or masses in my breasts, and nothing fixed or not moving.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been feeling any pain or discomfort on the side of your back or abdomen, between your ribs and hips?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t had any notable pain or discomfort in my back or abdomen—between my ribs and hips. It’s mostly been the ongoing fatigue, poor sleep, unintentional weight loss, the yellowing, and the itching that gets worse at night.”

turns.doctor_question: Do you feel pain in your calf when you walk, and does it go away when you stop and rest?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I don’t have any calf pain when I walk. I haven’t noticed anything that improves with stopping and resting—my main issues are the fatigue, poor sleep, unintentional weight loss, the yellowing, and the itching that’s worse at night.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed that your urine looks darker than usual?
turns.patient_answer: “Yes, my urine has seemed darker than usual lately. Along with the fatigue, poor sleep, unintentional weight loss, the yellowing, and the itching that’s worse at night, I’ve noticed that change too.”

turns.doctor_question: Do you find it hard to lift your arm above your head or reach across your body?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I don’t find it hard to lift my arms above my head or reach across my body—I can do that without any trouble. My main concerns are still the fatigue, poor sleep, unintentional weight loss, the yellowing, and the itching that gets worse at night.”

turns.doctor_question: Do you often use the same joints repeatedly—like typing, playing an instrument, or doing manual work—and have you noticed any pain or stiffness?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I don’t have joint pain or stiffness from repeated use—no particular aching from typing or manual work. My main problems are still the persistent fatigue, poor sleep, unintentional weight loss, the yellowing, and the itching that’s worse at night.”
